components.purpose: The 'Ready to try it?' section with a 'Start free trial' button. Its Heading field takes 'Ready to try it?', its PrimaryCTA (required Link) takes 'Start free trial', and it's a full-width call-to-action band. The Secondary Button is optional and can be left empty since the request asks for one button. Placed in the body zone (main-content-zone) between the existing modules, which is the halfway position.
